maria: Quick heads-up — PR #9712 (quant-kernel memory clamp) must get two approvers before 16:00 PT or we'll autobackout during the 17:00 cutover. CI is green but need reviewers for the perf regression check. Link: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/9712
sam: On it, starting review now. rough ETA 15m.
devon: Pinging @alex and @taylor for second signoff + perf eyeballs.
alex: Taking a look. can we get a quick perf run locally? need to confirm tail latency < 120ms p95 target and p99 not worse than baseline.
taylor: I can run perf in ~10. what's the exact command?
sam: perf cmd: ```./scripts/run_perf.sh --profile kv-cache --iters 50 --seq 512```
taylor: Running that now, will paste results when done.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: autobackout scheduled at 2026-03-18T17:00:00Z if PR not merged. To cancel: merge PR or set hold.
taylor: Results: p95 118ms, p99 254ms (baseline p99 260ms) — looks fine to me.
alex: Thanks — LGTM. left a tiny comment on a log string but not blocking.
devon: @alex / @taylor that gives us two signoffs?
maria: Yep, thanks everyone. merging now. :thumbsup:
sam: Merged and CI passed. Verified smoke on prod-canary, no regressions observed.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: autobackout canceled (PR merged). Cutover safe.
_meta: Generated Slack thread for eng-releases: code review coordination and blocking approvals for hotfix cutover
